children: The cost of insuring euro credit against default rises as risk appetite declines amid increasing sovereign bond yields. High sovereign bond yields and oil prices are contributing to weak risk sentiment, IG analysts say in a note. The iTraxx Europe Crossover index of euro high-yield credit default swaps rises 1 basis point to 252bps, S&P Global Market Intelligence data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
